question: For every relevant arbitrary-CNF residual of the frozen normative machine, must there exist at least one GLOBAL_ROOT_BUDGET envelope-admissible exact-DP pivot?

definitions.canonical_root: canonical tautology-free explicit CNF before cheap-policy saturation
definitions.root_budget: B0=(C0+L0)*(V0+1)^2, frozen once at the canonical root
definitions.relevant_residual: the deterministic frozen cheap-policy replay R33 -> terminal/affine -> RUP -> SA_BVE -> restart reaches kind=RESIDUAL from the root without any exact-DP step
definitions.local_certificate: For bipolar pivot x, RAW_S_UB(x)=S-M_x+(b_x*A_x+a_x*B_x-a_x*b_x), as frozen in AJ/AR
definitions.exact_size_admissible_DP_door: independently materialized exact canonical DP child has C'+L'<=T and removes x

primary_attack_family.name: PUNCTURED_EXTENDED_HAMMING_WEIGHT4_XOR_CNF
construction: Use n=2^m Boolean variables indexed by GF(2)^m points 0..n-1.
Enumerate every distinct 4-set {a,b,c,d} with a xor b xor c xor d = 0.
For each 4-set encode homogeneous XOR x_a xor x_b xor x_c xor x_d = 0 by its 8 canonical width-4 CNF clauses.

Add one full-width positive clause (x_0 OR ... OR x_{n-1}) excluding the all-zero codeword, which is a model of the homogeneous XOR system. This deliberately breaks affine closure before outcome observation.
Also retain the unpunctured affine formula as a diagnostic control only, never as a falsifier.
primary_attack_family.reason_for_attack: The weight-4 code supplies dense balanced bipolar incidence while the puncture prevents a legitimate AFFINE terminal. The family is specified before replay and is not selected using SAT truth or observed outcome.

secondary_frozen_attack_families.name: COMPLEMENT_PAIR_3_HYPERGRAPH
secondary_frozen_attack_families.rule: for lexicographic 3-subsets include (+++) and (---) until the frozen target count ceil(1.5*n^(7/3)) or exhaustion

search_order: all secondary candidates in the literal preregistered order
audit_protocol: Compute B0 from each canonical root before any cheap reduction.
Run the frozen cheap policy without exact DP.
If the result is TERMINAL or AFFINE, record it as non-falsifying and continue.
If the result is RESIDUAL, enumerate every bipolar residual variable and compute the frozen AJ/AR parent-only RAW_S_UB certificate with the original B0.
If at least one certificate-admissible pivot exists, record the minimum (RAW_S_UB,var) and continue.
If no certificate-admissible pivot exists, independently materialize exact canonical DP for every bipolar variable and test exact child S'<=T.
Seal the first relevant residual with zero certificate-admissible pivots. Do not mutate the family or selector after observing it.
Classify that witness as CERTIFICATE_ONLY_ROUTE_OBSTRUCTION when some exact-size-admissible pivot exists, or ACTUAL_DP_SIZE_ROUTE_OBSTRUCTION when none exists.
If no frozen candidate falsifies, report finite-search survival only; universal existence remains OPEN.
